facts.business: Jamshri Realty Limited develops and operates Jamshri City, a mixed-use campus in Solapur comprising retail leasing (Jamshri High Street), hospitality (quick-service formats, Shubham Resort & Banquets), and property services.

capacity_or_capex.item: Connplex Cinemas fit-out (box office, auditorium interiors, recliner seating, concession areas)
capacity_or_capex.timeline: Work in progress as of 31 March 2026

capacity_or_capex.item: Master planning by ANA (Ar. Avinash Nawathe) for approval-ready master plan

Execution risk on Connplex Cinemas fit-out and master plan approvals
